maddeler.e:
احتبسن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَبَسْنَ (iḥtabasna) /iħ.ta.bas.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# اُحْتُبِسْنَ (uḥtubisna) /uħ.tu.bis.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# اِحْتَبِسْنَ (iḥtabisna) /iħ.ta.bis.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
